visual_pipeline_law: Reference-First 35mm Live-Action Cinema Pipeline: (1) Approve isolated close-up Master Character Casting Portraits in shared_refs/characters/ and (2) uninhabited Master Location Plates in shared_refs/locations/ BEFORE (3) rendering single-camera 16:9 scene keyframes. Zero split-screens/diptychs, zero glass-chimney kerosene lamps (strictly open-wick clay/copper chiragh), zero crossguards on Caucasian shashkas (strictly guardless cleft-pommel ushki).
shamil_hair_henna_law: Imam Shamil [CHAR_01] is a natural Caucasian-Avar brunette with dense jet-black / very dark-brown hair, thick straight black eyebrows, and a dense jet-black beard with ZERO ginger/reddish/blond tint throughout childhood, youth, Season 1 (1797-1839), and early-to-mid 1840s. The copper-reddish tone appears ONLY in older age (late 1840s-1860s, Seasons 3-4) when he dyed his greying beard with henna by sunnah custom.

state_rules.description: Shamil acquires permanent Gimry chest/back scar in S1E03_SC06; no scene prior to E03 Sc.6 may mention it, all scenes from E03 Sc.6 onward preserve it.
Surkhai Tower [LOC_S1_14A] is pulverized on July 4, 1839 in S1E07_SH01; every subsequent shot mentioning LOC_S1_14A must reflect rubble/Russian mountain battery, never an intact tower.
Captain D. A. Milyutin is shot in the right shoulder on July 16, 1839 in S1E07_SH02; from S1E07_SH03 through S1E08 his right arm must be in a black silk sling.
The hanging bridge [LOC_S1_14C] is cut on Aug 20, 1839 in S1E08_SH02; it cannot appear intact in S1E08_SH03-SH08.

Throughout Season 1 (1797-1839), Shamil [CHAR_01] is a natural Avar brunette with jet-black hair, straight black brows, and dense black beard (zero ginger, reddish, or blond hair/beard; henna is strictly Season 3-4).

Every shot keyframe must be a single continuous 35mm live-action camera frame (no diptychs, split-screens, or multi-location mashups), with open-wick chiragh lamps (no glass chimneys) and guardless cleft-pommel Caucasian shashkas.
